tools.name: get_player_state
tools.summary: The live player: now-playing episode, position/duration, speed, sleep timer, and queue head.
tools.returns: { nowPlaying: {episodeKey,title,show}|null, positionSec, durationSec, rate, paused, sleep: {kind,...}, queueLength, queueHead }. Use this as the health check and to read ground truth after acting.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.summary: Every show the user is subscribed to.

tools.name: find_shows
tools.summary: Resolve a show name to its id. Searches subscriptions; optionally the public directory.
tools.params: query (string, required); includeDirectory (bool, default false — also search the public directory for shows not yet subscribed); limit (default 10).
tools.returns: { subscribed: [{feedUrlHash, title, author}], directory: [{feedUrl, title, author}] }. Pass feedUrlHash as `show` to other tools; subscribe with a directory feedUrl.

tools.name: find_episodes
tools.summary: Resolve an episode by title text. Returns exact episodeKeys for follow-up calls.
tools.params: query (string, required); show (feedUrlHash, optional — scope to one show); unplayed (bool, optional); limit (default 10).
tools.returns: { episodes: [{episodeKey, title, show, showTitle, pubDate, durationSec, played}] }

tools.name: list_episodes
tools.summary: Episodes of one show, newest first.
tools.params: show (feedUrlHash, required); unplayed (bool); since (ISO date lower bound); limit (default 50).

tools.name: get_queue
tools.summary: The up-next queue, in order.

tools.name: list_bookmarks
tools.summary: The user's bookmarks and snips.
tools.params: episode (episodeKey, optional — scope to one episode).
tools.returns: { bookmarks: [{id, episodeKey, t, end?, note?, createdAt}] }

tools.name: get_show_settings
tools.summary: Per-show playback settings (speed, trims, normalize).
tools.returns: { show, settings: {speed?, skipIntroSec?, skipOutroSec?, trim?, normalize?, volumeTrim?} }

tools.name: get_global_settings
tools.summary: Global settings (download cap, AI-control toggles).

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.summary: The transcript cues for an episode (cache-first; fetches if needed).
tools.returns: { episode, source, cues: [{start, end, text}] } — or {episode, cues: []} when none is available.

tools.name: get_chapters
tools.summary: The chapter list for an episode (cache-first).

tools.name: search_heard_local
tools.summary: Full-text search over what the user ACTUALLY heard (local, accountless parity with the hosted search_heard).
tools.returns: { results: [{episodeKey, cueStart, cueEnd, text}] } — scoped to the listened-transcript, never un-heard audio. cueStart is the media-seconds position (pass it as `at` to play/seek/share).

tools.name: list_downloads
tools.summary: Episodes kept offline.

tools.name: get_storage_info
tools.summary: Offline storage usage and durability.
tools.returns: { usage?, quota?, persisted?, downloadCount, knownBytes, opaqueCount }

tools.name: export_opml
tools.summary: Export subscriptions as an OPML document.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.summary: Subscribe to a podcast by feed URL (or a directory result feedUrl).
tools.params: url (string, required) — the RSS feed URL.
tools.returns: { show: {feedUrlHash, title, author, feedUrl} } — the resulting subscription.

tools.name: unsubscribe
tools.summary: Unsubscribe from a show. The listening record survives; resubscribing restores the map.

tools.name: import_opml
tools.summary: Bulk-subscribe from an OPML document. Per-feed failures never abort the run.
tools.returns: { imported, failed, reports: [{url, title, ok, error?}] }

tools.name: queue_add
tools.summary: Add an episode to the up-next queue.
tools.returns: { queue: [{episodeKey, title}], added } — the queue after adding; `added` is false if it was already queued.

tools.name: queue_remove
tools.summary: Remove an episode from the queue.

tools.name: queue_move
tools.summary: Move a queued episode one slot up or down.

tools.name: queue_reorder
tools.summary: Rewrite the queue order. Omitted-but-queued episodes are appended after, never dropped.

tools.name: queue_clear
tools.summary: Empty the queue. The listening record is untouched.

tools.name: play
tools.summary: Play an episode now (streams from the publisher). Resumes at your last position unless `at` is given.
tools.params: episode (episodeKey, required); at (seconds, optional — start position).
tools.returns: { nowPlaying: {episodeKey, title}, positionSec }. Requires a live player tab.

tools.name: pause
tools.summary: Pause playback.

tools.name: resume
tools.summary: Resume playback.

tools.name: seek
tools.summary: Seek within the current episode. A real seek — recorded honestly, like the UI slider.
tools.params: exactly one of: to (absolute seconds) OR by (relative seconds, resolved against the live position).

tools.name: skip_to_chapter
tools.summary: Jump to a chapter of the current episode by index or title.
tools.params: exactly one of: index (0-based) OR title (case-insensitive match).

tools.name: next_in_queue
tools.summary: Play the next queued episode (pops the head).

tools.name: set_speed
tools.summary: Set playback speed. Persists per show when `show` is given (matches the UI).
tools.params: rate (0<rate<=5); show (feedUrlHash, optional — persist for this show).

tools.name: set_show_settings
tools.summary: Update per-show playback settings. Audio-path changes re-apply immediately if the show is playing.
tools.params: show (feedUrlHash, required); patch ({speed?, skipIntroSec?, skipOutroSec?, trim?, normalize?, volumeTrim?}).

tools.name: set_sleep_timer
tools.summary: Arm or clear the sleep timer.

tools.name: add_bookmark
tools.summary: Bookmark a moment. Defaults to the now-playing episode and current position.
tools.params: episode (episodeKey, optional); at (seconds, optional); note (string, optional).

tools.name: add_snip
tools.summary: Bookmark a range (a snip). Snaps to cue boundaries when a transcript exists.
tools.params: episode (episodeKey, optional — defaults to now-playing); start (seconds); end (seconds); note (optional).

tools.name: remove_bookmark
tools.summary: Delete a bookmark or snip by id.

tools.name: mark_played
tools.summary: Mark episodes as played (a synthetic full-length listen; rendered as its own state, never "heard").

tools.name: download_episode
tools.summary: Download an episode for offline (into the browser cache; audio never touches OpenPod).

tools.name: remove_download
tools.summary: Remove an offline download.

tools.name: set_download_cap
tools.summary: Set the max number of episodes kept offline (evicts over the cap).

tools.name: share_moment
tools.summary: Build a shareable deep link to a moment in an episode. Returns the link; posts nowhere.

tools.name: open_view
tools.summary: Bring the UI along — select a show/episode, open a panel tab, now-playing, or settings.

tools.name: play_segments
tools.summary: Play a set of moments back to back, right now — the answer, as audio.
tools.params: segments: [{episode, start, end, title?, reason?}] (media seconds). Ordered by start automatically.
tools.returns: { playing: n, first: {episode, start} }. Jumps between moments are recorded as automatic, so material skipped over stays UNHEARD on the listened map.

tools.name: plan_playback
tools.summary: Queue moments to play at a boundary instead of now — "jump there after this chapter".
tools.params: moments: [{episode, start, end, title?, reason?}]; after: 'now' | 'chapter' | 'episode' (default 'chapter').
tools.returns: { moments: n, after, boundary }. `boundary` is the media second it fires at. Prefer this over `seek` when the listener did not ask to move right now — do not yank the playhead mid-sentence to show off a find.

tools.name: clear_playback_plan
tools.summary: Drop the queued playback plan (and stop it if it is running).
